intro.title: Controlled DatePicker
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a controlled DatePicker component in React. You will learn how to manage a selected date as a state variable and update it based on user input. The core concept is controlled components, where React state serves as the single source of truth for form elements. You will use React's useState hook for state management and the HTML input element with type='date' for the date picker interface. This exercise will help you understand how to handle form inputs in a declarative React way.
intro.usecase: Controlled DatePickers are essential in any form-based application where users need to select dates with precision and validation. You'll find them in travel booking sites for selecting flight dates, in healthcare applications for scheduling appointments, and in financial dashboards for filtering transaction date ranges. As a developer, you'll implement controlled DatePickers when building event registration forms, project management tools with deadline selectors, or analytics platforms with time-based filters. This pattern ensures the selected date is always synchronized with your application state, enabling real-time validation and dynamic UI updates.
